name: tty
description: Terminal detection and information. Provides functions to check if file descriptors are connected to terminals and to get terminal dimensions.  @example tty::is_stdout if {     term::Green print "Success" print term::Reset print nl } else {     "Success" print nl }

functions.name: height
functions.description: Get terminal height in rows. Returns 0 if not a terminal.

functions.name: is_stderr
functions.description: Check if stderr is connected to a terminal.
examples: tty::is_stderr if { "Error output to terminal" print nl }

functions.name: is_stdin
functions.description: Check if stdin is connected to a terminal. Useful for detecting if input is piped.
examples: tty::is_stdin 0 == if { "Reading from pipe" print nl }

functions.name: is_stdout
functions.description: Check if stdout is connected to a terminal.

functions.name: size
functions.description: Get terminal dimensions. Returns 0, 0 if not a terminal.

functions.name: width
functions.description: Get terminal width in columns. Returns 0 if not a terminal.
